original_query: Add a new column to the table that calculates the difference between 'Preqin Median Net IRR' and 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR' to assess the outperformance of private investments over the public market for each vintage year.

import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')
df['IRR vs PME Difference'] = (df['Preqin Median Net IRR'] - df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR']).round(2)
